links.outcome: Radiologist AUC and sensitivity with versus without AI assistance in reader study
links.effect: Human-AI collaboration increased radiologists' average AUC by 10.58% and sensitivity by 22.48% (n = 284 cases, six radiologists).
links.quote: Furthermore, a prospective reader study (n = 284 cases, six radiologists) demonstrated that UMORSS as a human-AI collaborative tool increased radiologists' average AUC by 10.58% and sensitivity by 22.48%.

links.outcome: Phase II AUC in internal testing versus external validation
links.effect: Phase II AUC was 0.955 in internal testing and 0.926 in external validation, a modest drop at external sites.
links.quote: Phase II achieved an AUC of 0.955 (internal testing) and 0.926 (external validation).

unlisted_practices: Two-phase triage workflow that uses ultrasound-only analysis to rule out low-risk lesions before multimodal analysis
Uncertainty quantification to flag complex cases for multimodal analysis

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing radiologists' diagnostic performance with and without the AI system (evaluating human-AI collaboration and an uncertainty-aware triage workflow).
